text: {"text":"The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated; the status of the other two is unknown. Migrating twelve known clients is substantial progress, but the evidence has an exact boundary: integration tests cover those twelve migrated clients and do not cover the other two. I therefore recommend that the aliases not be removed until the owners of the two remaining clients confirm migration. The available evidence supports continued migration work, but does not support alias removal: continue the migration; retain the compatibility aliases."}
